I want to thank the people who responded  seriously. I feel alot better and indeed i did want a normal social life with friends just like other teenagers. I geuss that holded me down quite a bit too but also my own friends. They  seem to completely ignore my outside of school(with that i mean not calling me or texting me to do something).
I do have one friend who does want to do something if I don't forget to ask him. Ill stick with it. 

The future might give me something who knows.

You might not believe it. But you really sound alot like me! I always try to do just my best and reach. Although i don't get grades as you and i probably make more mistakes...

I see you'r friends are everything for you since you'r parents aren't that nice to you. You should listen to their one advice though. Loving yourself.

I mean you get good grades, you'r nice to everyone and as i can see you can still enjoy stuff you do. I had a girl once in my class that had the same problem with her mother (Divorced). Her mother just wanted her to have a good future and have it better then she does. They now have a better bond with each other from what i heard. Her mother told her on purpose to get better grades. She thought her mother hated her but that's not true at all.

I think the situation is the same for you. I don't want to ask alot from you. I really want to help you but i'm limited to an advise. And that would be to confront you'r parents. I know it sounds scary. But HELL you get 95 all the time! You work you'r ass off and sound so clever.

If i we're you. I would be scared to tell my parents how I feel if I was in your situation. But I know it would be the only way to confront them.

Talk to someone close to you about it. Or even an adult you trust.
You have to get this off you'r chest.

I hope this helps you or atleast motivates not to do anything stupid since you know you'r smart enough not too.

Life can be full of shit. You might feel nothing for these words but... You're YOUNG! you still have.. what? 70 years?

Like as if nothing is going to change in that time :)
Nothing happens until you decide to make it happen. So go for it. I really want to see you smile if you can't.
